info.title: Meziantou.Framework.SnapshotTesting.Tool
info.description: CLI tool to approve Meziantou.Framework.SnapshotTesting snapshots

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve snapshots by renaming *.actual.* files to *.verified.*

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Prompt for each snapshot to approve or reject [default: False]

options.name: --folder
options.description: Folder to process. Uses current directory when not set.

options.name: --recurse
options.description: Allow recursive search for __snapshots__ folders [default: True]
